This post is to announce that the subverse has a new moderator. After months of inactivity by the previous moderators I requested and received permission to moderate the sub so as to have the ability to market and improve the sub as only a moderator can.

My plan is to advertise to gain more subscribers and connect with other Cleveland related subs, as well as the subs for other nearby cities. I also hope to make some changes to the appearance of the subverse to make it more Cleveland oriented. Lastly, I want to add to our content by promoting themes and subjects to post about.

Initial “rules” - I believe in the axiom “build and moderate, not restrict and punish”. I want to add to the sub not weigh it down with ridiculous rules that seek to restrict free speech. The subscribers of this sub have the ability to interpret what is not “Cleveland subverse material” through the use of the downvoat and upvoat buttons. My only plans of enforcement will be to remove obvious spam that has no connection to Cleveland and block users who post the spam. Beyond that, I am here to serve and build.

If you have any suggestions or want to help build this sub please let me know. If you think we should have some sort of additional rules, then yes, please post about it. This subverse is about the subscribers and what they want.
